data.title: Kantone Disposes of 1.75 Million China Star Shares
data.description:

Kantone Holdings principally sells systems products, licenses and customises software, leases systems products and trades cultural products. data.title: Virscend Education Reports Higher Revenue but Lower Annual Profit
data.description:

data.title: Nanjing Leads Biolabs Enrolls First Patient in Confirmatory Phase III EP-NEC Study
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Nanjing Leads Biolabs Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:9887) ).

Nanjing Leads Biolabs develops innovative biological products, including LBL-024 (opamtistomig), an anti-PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific antibody, for cancer treatment. Its clinical work described here also covers SCLC, BTC, HCC and ovarian cancer.

On Nov. 27, 2026, the first patient was enrolled in a confirmatory, randomized, double-blind, multicenter Phase III study of LBL-024 plus platinum-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment for advanced EP-NEC; overall survival is the primary endpoint. The LBL-024 monotherapy NDA for advanced EP-NEC had been accepted by China’s NMPA and included in its priority review and approval procedure, while company-reported studies cited median OS of 8.7 months in later-line EP-NEC and an 18-month OS rate of 55.7% in first-line EP-NEC combination treatment.

data.description:

data.title: Palasino Reports Interim Results for Six Months Ended September 2026
data.description:
Palasino Holdings Limited ( (HK:2536) ) has issued an update.

For the six months ended 30 September 2026, revenue from gaming, hotel, catering, leasing and related services fell 4% to approximately HK$293.3 million, while gaming revenue declined 7% to approximately HK$204.1 million amid higher energy costs and reduced consumer discretionary spending. Hotel revenue rose 4% to HK$51.9 million, with average daily room rate up 1%, occupancy up 2% and RevPAR up 2%.

Profit attributable to owners fell to approximately HK$7.2 million from approximately HK$11.6 million, while adjusted EBITDA declined to approximately HK$20.9 million from HK$31.2 million. Palasino Mikulov, which commenced operations in late March 2026, remained in its early ramp-up stage; excluding it, profit would have been approximately HK$22.1 million. The Group rolled out customer incentive and loyalty programmes and invested heavily in marketing and promotions, while the Board did not recommend an interim dividend.

data.title: HK.AI Capital Announces Unaudited Results for Six Months Ended 30 September 2026
data.description:

data.title: China Qinfa Reports Progress at Indonesia SDE Coal Project
data.description:
China Qinfa Group Ltd. ( (HK:0866) ) has issued an announcement.

SDE Mine 1 attained full-capacity capability during the current year, while SDE Mine 2 commenced production as planned and began contributing output. Together, the mines produced more than 2 million tonnes of raw coal from 1 October to 22 November in the fourth quarter, while the company said the project’s operating performance remained sound.

The company said its subsidiary SDE complied with Indonesian laws, paid taxes and non-tax state revenue, and carried out community programmes. Kotabaru Regency awarded SDE a certificate of honour on 10 November 2026; local Indonesian employees numbered 3,181 as of 31 October, with more than 90% in Kotabaru, and the company said the project had local-government and community support.

Against recent media reports about remarks by President Prabowo Subianto on mining-license proceeds, the Board said SDE’s construction, mining and operations complied with currently effective Indonesian laws and regulations. It also said SDE’s mining licenses and core approvals were lawfully issued, legal and valid, and supported by a sufficient legal basis.

data.title: Great Harvest Maeta Says Bondholder Agrees to Settlement Extension
data.description:
An update from Great Harvest Maeta Holdings Limited ( (HK:3683) ) is now available.

The company said the bondholder prefers a cash-and-land settlement and may consider concessions, while a potential investor is conducting due diligence for financing.

On 26 November 2026, the bondholder gave written notice agreeing to extend settlement of the Top Build Convertible Bonds from 31 December 2026 to 31 January 2028, subject to a later extension agreement. The company said it had made no repayment of the outstanding redemption amount from 31 March 2026 through the announcement date and would continue negotiations.

data.title: Far East Consortium Reports Higher Adjusted Cash Profit, Lower Debt
data.description:
Far East Consortium International ( (HK:0035) ) has issued an update.

Far East Consortium International’s businesses cover property development and hotel operations and management, with activities described in Hong Kong, the UK, Australia and Malaysia. In the six months ended 30 September 2026, adjusted cash profit rose 122.9% to HK$453 million, while net profit attributable to shareholders was HK$255 million, compared with a net loss in the same period last year.

Revenue fell 34.1% to approximately HK$2.3 billion, primarily because residential project completions and handovers followed their scheduled phasing; adjusted revenue fell 21.9% to approximately HK$3.7 billion. Adjusted property development revenue was approximately HK$2.1 billion, with Victoria Riverside Tower A in Manchester and The Star Residences Tower 2 – Epsilon in Australia completing in July 2026, followed by handover activity.

Hotel operations and management revenue increased 4.4% to approximately HK$1,117 million, reflecting progressive stabilisation at Dorsett Kai Tak and higher occupancy and revenue per available room across Hong Kong and Australia. Total bank loans, notes and bonds fell HK$1,654 million to HK$21,823 million, while net debt fell HK$1,413 million to HK$18,387 million and adjusted net gearing declined to 58.8%.
